src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    full_rows = {r: g[r][0] for r in range(h) if all(v == g[r][0] for v in g[r])}
    full_cols = {c: g[0][c] for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] for r in range(h))}
    shared = set(full_rows.values()) & set(full_cols.values())
    if not shared:
        return g
    # The divider color is the one appearing as both full rows and full columns.
    color = max(shared, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for v in full_rows.values()) + sum(v == x for v in full_cols.values()))
    rs = [r for r, v in full_rows.items() if v == color]
    cs = [c for c, v in full_cols.items() if v == color]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sorted(rs) + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sorted(cs) + [w]
    row_ranges = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_ranges = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_ranges for c0, c1 in col_ranges]
    vals = [g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in rs and c not in cs]
    background = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(g[r][c] != background for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    tile = [g[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0, r1)]
    for a, b, x, y in panels:
        if (a, b, x, y) == source:
            continue
        for r in range(a, b):
            for c in range(x, y):
                g[r][c] = tile[r-a][c-x]
    return g
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(src)
